meta.expect: 'put it in an email', no list

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40. Why was my son's mark changed to a zero without a phone call?
I didn't ask for pleasantries, Hale. I asked why there was a zero in the gradebook before anyone called me.
Let me show you the version history. The document was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, and 1,406 words arrived in two pastes six minutes apart.
"Pastes" is your word. Turn the screen around and show me what the document actually says. You also still haven't answered my question about the phone call.
Can you summarize what we've agreed so far in bullet points?
Put it in an email, Hale. We haven't agreed to anything, and my terms haven't changed: the zero comes off the gradebook today, or I'm going upstairs to the principal.
Just a quick numbered list is fine.
I said put it in an email. There is no list, because nothing has been agreed, and you still haven't turned that screen around or told me why nobody called me.
